messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall — routing-health-swing detected. Multiple regions reporting alternating unhealthy -> healthy probes (us-east <-> us-west <-> eu). Auto-fallbacks triggered. Correlation id: hopchain-2287

maria: I'm on it. seeing 30s spike pattern where health checks flip between 200/500 across regions. Routing loop causing lots of cross-region fallbacks.

sam: any customer impact yet? severity?

maria: yes — elevated error rate on generation endpoints, ~5% global errors, tail latency up ~600ms. A few customers reported model mismatch errors (wrong variant returned after fallback). Seems fallback picked an incompatible quantized variant in eu.

jordan: digging into routing policy history — there was a policy tweak yesterday to prefer lower-cost variants for fallback. It looks like that policy doesn't verify model-compatibility labels, so eu gets chosen even if it's not compatible with the requested variant.

lee: logs snippet from router (latest):
```
[router] 2023-11-15T12:03:05Z route->eu fallback chosen (score 0.78)
[serving-eu] 2023-11-15T12:03:05Z model-load err: incompatible-quant (expected float16, got int8-quant)
[router] 2023-11-15T12:03:35Z route->us-west fallback chosen (score 0.81)
[serving-us-west] 2023-11-15T12:03:35Z health: 200
[router] 2023-11-15T12:04:05Z route->us-east fallback chosen (score 0.79)
```

maria: looks like three-way hopchain: probe bounce -> fallback to cheaper variant -> compatibility error or slow warmup -> upstream health flip -> repeat.

sam: immediate mitigation suggestions?

maria: plan: 1) throttle cross-region fallback (disable auto-fallback across regions), 2) enforce model-compatibility check in routing (quick guard), 3) rollback yesterday's 'prefer-low-cost' policy temporarily. I can push (1) now.

jordan: I'll prepare the commands. running: 
```
rcli routing set --region-fallback enabled:false --scope global --reason "mitigate hopchain flipflop"
kubectl -n redwood patch configmap routing-policy -p '{"data":{"prefer-low-cost":"false"}}'
```

jordan: applied both. kubectl patch returned 200. rcli command exited 0.

incident-bot: action recorded: routing global region-fallback disabled by jordan at hopchain-2287.

maria: monitoring... errors dropping. current error rate 0.9% (was 5%), p95 latency down to normal. Good sign.

support-bot: customers flagged: acct-12345, acct-67890 reported 502s. Support notified them and opened tickets. No data loss, just request failures and retries.

lee: quick root-cause hypothesis: health-check thresholds were tightened in eu last week + policy allowed picking variants without compatibility checks. Combined, that made eu look briefly healthy for routing but actually returned incompatible artifacts.

sam: agree. next steps: 1) revert policy (done), 2) add compatibility label check to routing decision (temp guard), 3) add short-circuit circuit-breaker to avoid immediate cross-region fallback loops, 4) produce postmortem and runbook update.

jordan: creating ENG ticket ENG-4872 for compatibility check and ENG-4873 for circuit-breaker. I'll attach logs and config diffs.

maria: I'll keep monitoring for 1h then hand off to next oncall. Leaving local pins for affected customers for now (no cross-region fallback).

lee: copying remediation steps to #postmortems and will own the follow-up. Can someone confirm whether any dedicated customers on Dedicated instances were affected?

support-bot: quick check: Dedicated customers in us-west and us-east saw retries but no persistent errors; eu dedicated clusters had a small window (~10m) of failed model loads but recovered after rollback.

sam: good. timeline for permanent fix? jordan?

jordan: estimate: compatibility guard PR 2 days, circuit-breaker 3 days, testing + rollout 1 week. I'll tag docs and QA.

maria: handoff — I'm handing to @lee for the night shift in 25m. I'll stay around for first 30m of monitoring.

lee: ack. I'll run a health-check sweep and add synthetic traffic to ensure no re-trigger. Also will add a metric alarm for "consecutive region-fallbacks > 3".

maria: thanks team. posting incident notes to #incidents-postmortem later. Ops follow-up: add canary for policy changes so we don't globally enable prefer-low-cost without compatibility checks.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigated — routing fallbacks throttled and policy rolled back. Severity: Sev2 -> mitigated. All hands: please update ENG tickets and runbook.

sam: closing loop — no customer data lost, short outage window, primary cause: policy mismatch + aggressive health thresholds leading to hopchain flipflop. Follow-ups assigned.

lee: +1. will create the alerting PR and post links to the postmortem once done.

maria: handing off fully to @lee now. leaving logs and commands in the incident doc.

opsbot: Note: oncall handoff recorded. Next oncall: lee.

jordan: PRs opened: ENG-4872 (compat-check), ENG-4873 (circuit-breaker). linking to this thread.

support-bot: tickets opened for customers and support notified.

maria: thanks everyone, monitoring continues for 30m then I'll mark resolved if stable. :thumbsup:
